defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its Bron-Kerbosch maximal-independent-set reduction does not correctly and robustly enforce a disjoint partition of all vertices into exactly three independent color classes, so maximal independent sets alone can produce an incorrect coloring decision or reconstruction.

recommended_edit: Replace the vague numbering warning with an explicit adversarial-order warning: state that module IDs may be permuted so that numerical-order lexicographic DFS with buses tried in increasing order has exponentially many locally consistent prefixes before the decisive conflict, and that solvers must use an effective variable-ordering or pruning strategy.
